notes_for_editor: Thin. The Forest Lookouts page carries only the name and county. TopoZone's Bell County tower list confirms the name and nothing else. Two searches and about eight page reads turned up no construction date, design, staffing, status or access. Not on the NHLR or FFLOS Kentucky lists (checked 2026-10-21). Kentucky Ridge State Forest (Wikipedia, Bell County) shares the name, but no source ties the tower to it. The record's point (36.7304, -83.773) came from the record; no text on either page gives coordinates, so it is unchecked. Story is about 50 words, below the 120-word floor, on purpose. Editor may want to keep it as a stub or hide it until a source turns up.
